name: codex-host-bridge
description: A private editor context companion for the Coding Kanban session workspace.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Read editor text, navigate and display Diff without executing project code. Language queries still require an explicit user setting.

commands.title: Coding Kanban: Add File or Selection to Session

codingKanban.host.todoCodeLens.description: Offer a session context action on TODO comments. This adds a draft context and never sends an Agent message.

codingKanban.host.lsp.description: Allow the session bridge to query VS Code definition providers. No LSP server is started by this setting.
